notablePrerequisites:
You control any other mana-producing land.
Argothian Elder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Attack with Argothian Elder.
Activate Maze of Ith by tapping it, untapping Argothian Elder and preventing all combat damage that would be dealt to and by it this turn.
Activate Argothian Elder by tapping it, untapping Maze of Ith and any other land.
Activate that land by tapping it to add mana.
Repeat from step 2.
